english: Tradition is an important part of Igbo life.
igbo: Ọdịnala bụ akụkụ dị mkpa nke ndụ ndị Igbo.

english: The Igbo people have many traditions.
igbo: Ndị Igbo nwere ọtụtụ omenala.

english: Tradition teaches us about our ancestors.
igbo: Ọdịnala na-akụziri anyị ihe gbasara ndị nna nna anyị.
Ezinụlọ ahụ na-asọpụrụ omenala ha.
Anyị kwesịrị ichekwa omenala anyị.
Ụmụaka na-amụta omenala n'aka ndị okenye.
Ndị okenye na-akụziri ụmụaka akụkọ ọdịnala.
Akụkọ ọdịnala na-akụzi ọtụtụ ihe.

english: The grandmother told a story at night.
igbo: Nne ochie kọrọ akụkọ n'abalị.

english: The children sat and listened to the story.
igbo: Ụmụaka nọdụrụ gee akụkọ ahụ ntị.

english: Music is part of Igbo culture.
igbo: Egwu bụ akụkụ nke omenala Igbo.
Ndị mmadụ na-agba egwu n'emume.
Ha na-abụ abụ ọdịnala.
Egwu ahụ na-atọ ụtọ.
Ndị egwu na-akpọ ngwá egwu.

english: The ubo-aka is one of the traditional musical instruments.
igbo: Ụbọ aka bụ otu n'ime ngwá egwu ọdịnala.
Ọtụtụ mmadụ hụrụ egwu ọdịnala n'anya.
Egwu na-ejikọta ndị mmadụ ọnụ.
Ndị mmadụ na-eji egwu eme emume.
Ha na-akpọ egwu n'oge emume.

english: Dancing is part of the celebration.
igbo: Ịgba egwu bụ akụkụ nke emume.
Ụmụaka na-agba egwu nke ọma.
Ha yi uwe ọdịnala.
Uwe ọdịnala ahụ mara mma.
Ndị inyom yi akwa mara mma.
Ndị nwoke yi uwe ọdịnala.

english: Traditional clothing shows a person's culture.
igbo: Uwe ọdịnala na-egosi omenala mmadụ.

english: People wear traditional clothing for celebrations.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-eji akwa eme emume.

english: The traditional celebration began in the morning.
igbo: Emume ọdịnala ahụ malitere n'ụtụtụ.

english: Many people came to the celebration.
igbo: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ bịara emume ahụ.

english: The celebration took place in the town.
igbo: Emume ahụ mere n'obodo.

english: The community prepared for the celebration.
igbo: Ndị obodo kwadebere maka emume ahụ.
Emume ahụ gara nke ọma.
Ha ji obi ụtọ mee emume ahụ.

english: People greet one another at celebrations.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-enye ibe ha ekele n'emume.

english: A visitor came to the house.
igbo: Ọbịa bịara n'ụlọ ahụ.
Ha nabatara ọbịa nke ọma.

english: Welcoming visitors is an important tradition.
igbo: Ịnabata ọbịa bụ omenala dị mkpa.
Ndị Igbo na-akwanyere ndị ọbịa ùgwù.

english: They gave food to the visitor.
igbo: Ha nyere ọbịa nri.

english: Traditional food is part of culture.
igbo: Nri ọdịnala bụ akụkụ nke omenala.

english: People cook traditional food at celebrations.
igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-esi nri ọdịnala n'emume.

english: The house was filled with the smell of food.
igbo: Ụlọ ahụ jupụtara n'isi nri.
Ha siri ji na ofe.
Nri ahụ na-atọ ụtọ.
Ezinụlọ ahụ riri nri ọnụ.
Ịkekọrịta nri na-eme ka ndị mmadụ dịrị n'otu.

english: The community prepares food for visitors.
igbo: Ndị obodo na-akwadebe nri maka ndị ọbịa.

english: They use traditional items to prepare food.
igbo: Ha na-eji ihe ọdịnala akwadebe nri.

english: Traditional food reflects the history of a community.
igbo: Nri ọdịnala na-egosi akụkọ obodo.

english: Names are an important part of culture.
igbo: Aha bụ akụkụ dị mkpa nke omenala.

english: Parents choose their children's names carefully.
igbo: Ndị nne na nna na-ahọrọ aha ụmụ ha nke ọma.
Aha ahụ nwere ihe ọ pụtara.

english: They named the child after his grandfather.
igbo: Ha kpọrọ nwa ahụ aha nna nna ya.
Aha ụfọdụ na-echeta ndị nna nna.

english: The Igbo people respect their ancestors.
igbo: Ndị Igbo na-asọpụrụ ndị nna nna ha.

english: We remember the stories of our ancestors.
igbo: Anyị na-echeta akụkọ ndị nna nna anyị.

english: Elders tell stories about the past.
igbo: Ndị okenye na-akọ akụkọ banyere oge gara aga.

english: The stories of ancestors are important.
igbo: Akụkọ ndị nna nna dị mkpa.
Anyị kwesịrị ịmụta ihe n'akụkọ ihe mere eme.

english: The town has a long history.
igbo: Obodo ahụ nwere akụkọ ogologo.

english: The old building is part of the town's history.
igbo: Ụlọ ochie ahụ bụ akụkụ nke akụkọ obodo.
Ndị obodo na-echekwa ebe akụkọ ihe mere eme.
Akụkọ ihe mere eme na-akụziri anyị ihe.
Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-amụ banyere omenala ha.
Ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ na-akụzi akụkọ ọdịnala.

english: Teachers tell stories about the community.
igbo: Ndị nkuzi na-akọ akụkọ banyere obodo.
Ụmụaka kwesịrị ịma omenala ha.
Ọmụmụ omenala na-enyere ụmụaka aka.
Omenala na-ejikọta ọgbọ dị iche iche.

english: The new generation learns from elders.
igbo: Ọgbọ ọhụrụ na-amụta ihe n'aka ndị okenye.
Ndị ntorobịa na-akwado omenala ha.
Omenala na-agbanwe ka oge na-aga.

english: Some traditions are still alive today.
igbo: Ụfọdụ omenala ka dị ndụ taa.
Anyị kwesịrị ịkwanyere omenala dị iche iche ùgwù.
Obodo dị iche iche nwere omenala dị iche iche.
Ndị mmadụ na-asụ asụsụ dị iche iche.

english: Language is an important part of culture.
igbo: Asụsụ bụ akụkụ dị mkpa nke omenala.

english: Igbo is the language of the Igbo people.
igbo: Igbo bụ asụsụ ndị Igbo.

english: Language preserves the history of a community.
igbo: Asụsụ na-echekwa akụkọ obodo.
Ndị nne na nna na-akụziri ụmụ ha Igbo.
Ụmụaka kwesịrị ịmụ asụsụ ha.
Asụsụ na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka ịkparịta ụka.

english: The community uses Igbo during celebrations.
igbo: Ndị obodo na-eji Igbo eme emume.

english: Many people speak Igbo at home.
igbo: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-asụ Igbo n'ụlọ.

english: Respecting elders is an important tradition.
igbo: Ịkwanyere ndị okenye ùgwù bụ omenala dị mkpa.
Ụmụaka na-ekele ndị okenye.
Ndị okenye na-enye ndụmọdụ.

english: We should listen to elders' advice.
igbo: Anyị kwesịrị ige ndụmọdụ ndị okenye ntị.
Ndị mmadụ na-enyere ibe ha aka.

english: Working together is a good tradition.
igbo: Ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ bụ omenala dị mma.
Ndị obodo rụkọrọ ọrụ ọnụ.
Ha nyere ezinụlọ ahụ aka.
Ịdị n'otu na-eme ka obodo sie ike.
Omenala na-akụzi ịdị n'otu.
Ndị Igbo ji ezinụlọ kpọrọ ihe.

english: The family is the foundation of the community.
igbo: Ezinụlọ bụ isi obodo.
Ndị ezinụlọ na-akwado ibe ha.

english: Our culture is something we should value.
igbo: Omenala anyị bụ ihe anyị kwesịrị iji kpọrọ ihe.
Ịchekwa omenala na-enyere ọgbọ na-abịa aka.
